jobs.description:
Applying to this job will open a new window on the employer's web site to apply there.

Posted Date 8/07/2026

Description

This position is open until filled. To ensure consideration, applications should be received by Monday, August 24.

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as all-tier support for the agency's Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incidents; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To

Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Provide technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.

Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. Starting salary is determined by the required qualifications for the role and the candidate’s relevant experience. This is a full-time exempt position working primarily in the office Monday through Friday.

We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Up to 26 days of accrued paid time off annually in the first year (13 vacation/13 sick days), and 12 paid holidays. This position is required to participate in Washington PERS (Public Employee Retirement Services).

Requirements

Knowledge and Attributes

Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.

Collaboration and Teamwork

To be considered for this opportunity, you must:

jobs.title: Care Coordinator - LTC
jobs.description:
On MetLife’s Global Customer Service and Operations (GCSO) team, customer care is built on trust, empathy, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Whether guiding customers through life’s important moments, solving challenges, or simplifying processes with innovative technology, you’ll help deliver a differentiated experience grounded in operational excellence. Backed by a collaborative team, you’ll play a vital role in strengthening the way we care and advocate for millions worldwide. Here, making a real difference isn’t just a goal - it’s what we do, one conversation at a time.

The Opportunity

The LTC Care Coordinator is responsible for managing initial long term care benefit eligibility determinations through comprehensive case review, detailed analysis of medical and policy information, and timely, accurate claims decision-making. This role supports MetLife's commitment to helping customers navigate life's changing needs by ensuring fair, balanced, and compliant eligibility reviews for policyholders across the world. The position plays a critical role in delivering a positive customer experience through effective communication, thorough documentation, and informed decision-making while partnering with medical, legal, and customer resources as needed. This is an exciting opportunity to leverage critical thinking, investigative skills, and compassionate customer engagement to make meaningful decisions that directly impact customers and their families during important life events.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities
:

Manages assigned caseload of initial eligibility files with limited supervision.
Utilizes critical thinking and independent judgment and analysis to provide timely, balanced, and accurate claims decisions in a time sensitive, compliance driven and fast paced environment.
Compiles file documentation requiring extensive policy and factual detail.
Identifies information and resources needed to make initial benefit eligibility determinations, to include review of detailed medical information and other documentation necessary for rendering initial eligibility decision.
Communicates decisions to policyholders and or their representatives in both verbal and written form.
Composes highly detailed letters to policyholders and or their representatives outlining status of review and basis of determination.
Clarifies and reconciles inconsistencies.
Conducts in depth detailed information-gathering phone calls that obtain medical condition details and other information.
Engages with various medical and legal resources in situations where warranted.
Represents MetLife at deposition and trial due to first party litigation environment.

Required

Required Qualifications

Must live commutable distance to Tampa Florida Office
training class starts on 9/28/26
Strong communication skills, both written and oral
Demonstrated critical thinking in activities requiring analysis, investigation, and/or planning
Experience using MS office products
Strong organizational skills.
High School Diploma/GED and 3-5 years related experience

Preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree

The expected salary range for this position is $50,000 - $57,500 . This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation and stock-based long-term incentives. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.

Benefits We Offer

Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please click here.

About MetLife

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description

Thompson Ventures is a technology and research organization developing DELTA, an advanced AI system focused on governed cognition, contextual reasoning, semantic understanding, persistent knowledge, and long-horizon problem solving. DELTA is being engineered to move beyond conventional prompt-response AI by combining structured perception, source-bound reasoning, persistent state, evaluation, and controlled execution within a unified architecture.

Development emphasizes deterministic behavior where appropriate, traceable evidence and provenance, rigorous evaluation, operational reliability, and clear boundaries between reasoning, memory, external models, tools, and executable actions. Thompson Ventures takes an experimental, engineering-driven approach to AI development, using measurable capability evaluations and iterative validation to determine whether new functionality produces genuine improvements rather than superficial feature growth.

Role Description

The Senior Data Analyst will support the research, evaluation, and continued development of DELTA by transforming system-generated data into measurable evidence about capability, reliability, and performance.

The role involves collecting, cleaning, structuring, and analyzing data produced through DELTA's evaluations, runtime operations, experiments, and development campaigns. The analyst will design metrics and analytical frameworks for measuring areas such as semantic comprehension, reasoning consistency, retrieval quality, task completion, failure modes, duplication, latency, resource utilization, and capability improvement over time.

Day-to-day responsibilities may include building datasets from evaluation results and runtime evidence, developing dashboards and reports, performing statistical analyses, comparing system behavior across development checkpoints, identifying regressions and emerging capability gaps, and translating experimental results into actionable recommendations.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with DELTA's development and research efforts to determine whether architectural changes produce statistically and operationally meaningful improvements. This includes helping design reproducible evaluations, establishing baselines, analyzing before-and-after performance, identifying confounding variables, and ensuring conclusions remain grounded in available evidence.

The role may also contribute to the development of analytics standards, automated evaluation pipelines, data-quality controls, experiment documentation, and methods for tracking DELTA's progress across long-running research and engineering initiatives.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong analytical and data-analysis skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical datasets and distinguish meaningful performance changes from noise.

A solid understanding of statistics and experimental analysis is important for designing evaluations, establishing baselines, comparing results, validating findings, and identifying limitations in available evidence.

Candidates should have experience with data modeling and data pipelines, including structuring data for longitudinal analysis, reporting, experimentation, and reproducible evaluation.

Strong SQL skills and experience with Python or R are preferred. Experience with visualization and business-intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or comparable analytical environments is beneficial.

Candidates should be capable of communicating technical findings clearly, including explaining metrics, uncertainty, anomalies, regressions, and experimental results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience analyzing AI/ML systems, software telemetry, model evaluations, experiments, benchmarks, or other complex technical systems is particularly valuable. Direct experience developing machine-learning models is beneficial but not required.

A bachelor's or master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline is preferred, although substantial relevant experience may substitute for formal education.

Experience leading analytical projects, establishing evaluation methodologies, or mentoring other analysts is an advantage.

The position requires the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams, maintain rigorous documentation and reproducibility, work independently when necessary, and operate effectively within a rapidly evolving research and development environment.

The role offers flexible remote work while maintaining the ability to collaborate or work on-site in the Detroit Metropolitan Area when required.
